name: Tea Bowl with Indented Lip and Subtle Hare's-Fur Markings
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；13th century；Jian ware: dark gray stoneware with dark brown glaze, the markings in iron oxide, the lip banded with silver. From the kilns at Shuiji, Jianyang county, Fujian province.
